mods.name: VillageCraft 3 Essentials
mods.description: VillageCraft 3 Essentials is a mod built for the VillageCraft 3 Modpack which is used on the private SMP, VillageCraft 3. This mod adds custom ores to use as currency, which are copies of diamonds in every way. The other feature added is the ATM, a block which allows you to exchange currencies into another currency with random exchange rates. This mod also includes several other utility features for the SMP.

releases.notes:
## Villagecraft 3 Essentials 1.21.1pre-v1.0.6

### **Additions**
*   Added /{town} getroleplayitem
*   Added /{town} removejail
*   Added hiding player name tags according to Luckperms town roles when war features and its config option are enabled
*   Added full Create Goggles compat
*   Added Create Aeronautics compat
*   Added Malum compat
*   Added Simple Hats compat
*   Added Vanilla Backport compat
*   Added Vista compat
*   Added missing Aquaculture 2 tag and recipe to currency hooks
*   Added emissive textures to atm
*   Added a fourth row in the atm currency convert screen, allowing a total of four conversions on screen at once
*   Added animated input slot for converting tools in atm to show what can be converted
*   Added autofill for atm currency gem conversion input slot by clicking on the conversion button ang holding 'space'
*   Added missing compat items to atm tool conversion
*   Added Luckperms prefix and suffix stacking support
*   Added required Accessories dependency
*   Added jade currency and all respective tools, armors, blocks and compat items
*   Added silicon currency and all respective tools, armors, blocks and compat items
*   Added two sets of new town content for "London" and "BlackWater". This includes;
	*   Set of /{town} commands
	*   War season logic
	*   Bluemap logic
	*   Luckperms logic
	*   Ore worldgen
	*   Brassworks mission logic
*   Added jade and silicon into the atm currency and tools conversions, therefore increasing the amount of currency conversions to 20
*   Added jade and silicon armor trim pallets
*   Added four VillageCraft City roleplay item cosmetics
*   Added one Oasis roleplay item cosmetic
*   Added four Oasis roleplay item deeds
*   Added four Oasis roleplay item chips
*   Added two London roleplay item cosmetics
*   Added propeller hat

### **Removals** 
*   Removed Better Archaeology compat
*   Removed Galosphere compat
*   Removed Simple Guns: Reworked compat
*   Removed Elemental Wizards compat

### **Changes** 
*   Changed all common config options to server config
*   Changed atm break particle texture to use the atm texture
*   Changed /{town} jail commands to give permanent negative effects to the target player instead of setting them to adventure mode
*   Rebalanced ore generation to account for two new currency ores
*   Renamed default town group names to their respective citizen names
*   Renamed every mention of "Gripper City" to "Oasis"
*   Renamed every mention of "Amber Caves" to "Swedish Furniture Store"
*   Reworked how mod compat is handled (compat ghost items no longer exist)

### **Fixes**
*   Fixed Aquaculture 2 compat currency hook textures
*   Fixed broken atm tool conversions

### **Notes** 
*   Some jade and silicon textures are using placeholders, these will be gone and new textures will be completed in the next update 
*   Animated currency textures still only have diamond, ruby and amber; jade and silicon will be added into the animation in the next update
